facility: Briare Pumping Station, Canal de Briare, France
source: Arcadis for Voies navigables de France, Briare Pumping Station Pump Assessment Report, 2020 (Interreg Green WIN public deliverable)
question: Energy audit of the Briare pumping station: is the existing pump selection appropriate for the system, would variable speed drives save energy, and which measures should the operator take to reduce energy use? Quantify with the simulator where possible and state the data needed to confirm.

collection.question: Energy audit of Briare PS: is the existing Xylem CP3231 pump selection appropriate for the twin-900 mm / 2650 m / ~43 m system, would VSDs save energy, and which measures (new pump, IE3/IE4 motors, operating periods, automation, metering) should VNF take to reduce energy use? Quantify with the simulator where possible and state data needed to confirm.

rfi.issue: Pipe material unknown so ageing/friction uncertain
rfi.reason: Table 2 states Not known (p.6); design uses 0.3 mm with 0.03/1.5 mm cases (p.6, p.8, p.9)
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: adopt ks=0.3 mm as design base case and retain 0.03/1.5 mm as sensitivity band (p.6) because report provides curves for those values; require CCTV/coupon or pressure-drop test to confirm.

rfi.reason: Table 1 (p.6) differs from Figure 2 legend (p.8) and Table 3 (p.10); review states best fit was existing pump with closed C impeller (p.10)
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: treat all as same 435 mm closed-C CP3231 family and use Table 3/Figure 2 hydraulics (p.10, p.8) for audit because Xylem tool confirmed best fit to existing (p.10); require nameplate/curve confirmation.

rfi.issue: Table 3 Per Pump heading vs station totals
rfi.item: Flows 634/422/214 l/s and powers 398/265/133 kW labelled Per Pump (p.10) but scale with pump count and match 265 kW 2-pump station load (p.11)
rfi.reason: Values cannot be per-pump (e.g., 634 l/s per pump with 3 running); text notes specific energy almost same regardless of number running (p.10)
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: interpret Table 3 flows/powers as station totals for n pumps in parallel because they align with 265 kW prediction for two running pumps (p.11); require Xylem duty-point printouts to confirm per-pump split.

rfi.issue: Duty, drives and levels are assumed/from schematic
rfi.item: Duty/Duty/Assist +3 standby assumed; Fixed Speed assumed star-delta; Wet-well 124.2-125.8 mNGF based upon schematic (p.6)
rfi.reason: All flagged assumed or schematic-derived (p.6); firm-capacity and head depend on them
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: adopt Duty/Duty/Assist +3 standby, fixed-speed, and 124.2 low/124.9 design/125.8 high mNGF (p.6, p.9) for base model because they are the only stated basis; require VNF ops log, starter panel check, and level survey to confirm.

rfi.item: Figure 3 reach lengths/diameters/K, fluid properties, TVL/EVL and static-lift print (p.9)
rfi.reason: Image resolution obscures exact numbers, K breakdown, temperature/viscosity/density, and discharge TVL/Design/EVL (p.9)
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: fix geometry to 300 mm branches, 750 mm manifold, 2x900 mm x2650 m mains (p.6), areas 0.070686/0.441786/0.63617 m2, roughness Low 0.03/Design 0.3/High 1.5 mm, Total K 1.15/3.99/2.55/3.10, sump 125.8/124.9/124.2 mNGF, discharge ~168.0-168.1 mNGF, static ~42.3/43.1/43.9 m (p.6, p.9) because text tables control over pixels; require native calc file to rerun exactly.

rfi.issue: No flow measurement; VNF flow assumption arbitrary
rfi.item: No flow measurement have been undertaken (p.11); VNF uses arbitrary 200 l/s per pump and ignores supplementary loads to get 222 kWh/1000 m3 (p.11)
rfi.reason: Xylem predicts ~211-216 l/s per pump (422/2, 214, 424/2, 216) (p.10) vs 200 arbitrary (p.11); cannot validate 174 vs 222 without metering
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: use Xylem station flows 422 l/s (2 pumps) and 634-638 l/s (3 pumps) (p.10) for simulator and retain 222 as VNF-estimate only (p.11) because Xylem tool is the calibrated selection; require clamp-on/Inline flow + power logging to confirm.

rfi.issue: Supplementary load split not metered; 2018 dip unexplained
rfi.item: Base 10 kW summer /20 kW winter deduced (p.11); July-Aug 2018 -15 kW with no obvious explanation (p.11); Figure 4 monthly bars not tabulated
rfi.reason: Deduction from EDF 2017-2018 reports (p.11) without sub-metering; anomaly affects baseline
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: accept 10/20 kW base and 280 total/270 pumping/265 predicted for 2-pump validation (p.11) and exclude 15 kW dip as anomaly because report leaves it unexplained (p.11); require half-hourly EDF data and building-services sub-meter to confirm.

rfi.issue: Annual volume and 66% utilisation basis unclear
rfi.item: 2016 volume 2,907,360 m3 and 66% utilisation saving 3,873 /11,629 kWh/annum (p.11)
rfi.reason: Single-year volume (p.11) with no 2017-2018 volumes, hours, or tariff/ops-period data though optimising operations time periods is a goal (p.5)
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: accept 2,907,360 m3 and 66% (p.11) for illustrative IE3 savings only because no other volume given; require run-hours per pump, volumes, and tariff bands to confirm economics and VSD/period-optimisation case.

findings.evidence: Best fit was existing pump closed C (p.10); VNF assessment very good correlation (p.9). AUD-2P 424.8 l/s at 263.4 kW, 172.2 kWh/ML vs Table 3 station totals 422 l/s at 265 kW, 174 kWh/1000m3 (p.10) (+0.7%/-0.6%). AUD-1P 214.6 l/s at 132.1 kW vs 214 l/s at 133 kW (p.10). AUD-3P 627.2 l/s at 393.0 kW vs 634 l/s at 398 kW (p.10). EDF pumping ~270 kW vs 265 kW predicted aligns (p.11). Flat spec almost same regardless number running (p.10).
findings.modification: Retain CP3231 435mm hydraulics; renewal like-for-like. Data to confirm: nameplate/curve to resolve CP3231/705 53-455 (p.6) vs CP3231/735 435mm and /736 (p.10) vs 735/745 legend (p.8 image); Xylem duty printouts; flow+power log to replace arbitrary 200 l/s per pump (p.11).

findings.evidence: Elevation rise Approximately 43 m (p.6), 43 metres schematic (p.7 image), discharge 168.1 mNGF (p.6), wet well 124.2 to 125.8 mNGF (p.6). AUD-2P TDH 47.78m; AUD-2P-LOW 48.33m at 417.6 l/s; AUD-2P-HIGH 47.08m at 434.0 l/s. AUD-VSD80 0.0 l/s TDH 43.2m stalls. Twin 900mm x2650m (p.6); mains velocity 0.33 m/s per main AUD-2P, 0.49 m/s AUD-3P; velocity tool 211 l/s in 900mm =0.332 m/s; 211 l/s in 300mm =2.985 m/s vs AUD-2P branch 3.01 m/s.
findings.limiting_value: Static-dominated; VSD 0.8 stalls at static floor, VSD 0.95 still needs 46.42m; friction small across ks 0.03/0.3/1.5mm (p.6)(p.8 image)
findings.modification: Do NOT fit VSDs for energy saving to meet 422 l/s duty (p.10). Keep Fixed Speed assumed star-delta (p.6). VSD only if soft-start/control needed with lifecycle cost including drive/harmonic losses. Data to confirm: native calc Fig.3 (p.9 image), material Not known (p.6), pressure-drop test, digitised Fig.2 system curves (p.8 image).

findings.evidence: IE3 option CP3231/736 435mm 424 l/s 260 kW 77.4% 170 kWh/1000m3 vs existing 422 l/s 265 kW 75.4% 174 (p.10); 1-pump IE3 216 l/s 130 kW 77.8% 167 vs 214 l/s 133 kW 75.7% 172 (p.10); reduction approximately 4 kWh/1000m3 2- or 3-pump (p.10); N-impeller <1 kWh/1000m3 not presented (p.10). AUD-VSD90 273.5 l/s at 160.1 kW 162.6 kWh/ML and AUD-VSD95 355.3 l/s at 214.0 kW 167.3 kWh/ML use ASSUMPTION eff 0.80 no drive loss, so not comparable to Xylem 75-77% overall (p.10).
findings.modification: Implement >=1 new pump (p.5) with IE3 or IE4 motor; roll to all at renewal. N-impeller <1 (p.10) not justified alone; IE4 no data in report - require quote/curve. Data to confirm: run-hours/pump, 66% utilisation basis (p.11), IE4 offer, tariff.

findings.evidence: Operates 2 pumps most time up to 3 (p.6); Duty/Duty/Assist +3 Standby assumed (p.6). AUD-1P 214.6 l/s at 132.1 kW 171.0 kWh/ML vs AUD-2P 424.8 l/s at 263.4 kW 172.2 kWh/ML; Table 3 172 1-pump vs 174 2-pump (p.10). Scope automation/supervision/telecontrol + optimising periods (p.5). Firm 2-pump duty requires 3 available - met with 6 installed (p.6).
findings.limiting_value: 1-pump 172 vs 2-pump 174 kWh/1000m3 (p.10); no penalty for longer 1-pump running
findings.modification: Prefer extended 1-pump running via automation/duty-select; use 2/3 only for level/flow demand; optimise to off-peak tariffs. Data to confirm: ops log, control band 124.2-125.8 mNGF (p.6), starter-panel check, tariff bands.

findings.evidence: EDF 2017-2018 reviewed (p.11); base ~10 kW summer/~20 kW winter building services (p.11); summer ~280 kW total / ~270 kW pumping vs 265 kW predicted (p.11); 15 kW Jul-Aug 2018 dip no obvious explanation (p.11); VNF 222 kWh/1000m3 based on arbitrary 200 l/s per pump no supplementary loads (p.11) vs Xylem 211-216 l/s per pump (p.10); 2907360 m3 2016 (p.11); single-IE3 to 172 (p.11) vs all-IE3 170/167 (p.10); 3873 kWh/annum at 66% and 11629 kWh all pumps (p.11).
findings.limiting_value: ~10-20 kW base (p.11) ~4-7% of pumping load; 222 incorrect (p.11)
findings.modification: Sub-meter services, log half-hourly kW + flow + levels, resolve 15 kW dip, re-baseline 174 (p.10)(p.11). Data to confirm: half-hourly EDF, sub-meter, clamp-on flow, sump survey, 2016-18 volumes/hours, tariffs for optimising periods (p.5) + smart monitoring (p.5).

issues.evidence: Reruns match logged: BASE-2P 423.7 l/s 263.8 kW 172.9 kWh/ML, CHK-3P 622.6 l/s 392.9 kW, CHK-1P 214.7 l/s 132.4 kW, CHK-2P-LOW 416.5 l/s 262.2 kW, ALT-VSD-90 272.7 l/s 169.6 kW, ALT-VSD-80 0 l/s. No pump curve in p.6,p.8,p.10 - only duty points; Table 1 gives model/impeller/motor only (p.6).
issues.issue: Simulator pump rated point 211 l/s @ 48 m, eff 0.794, motor 170 kW, branch minor_k 8.0, C=110 are tuning ASSUMPTIONS to force +0.4%/-0.5% match, not document data. Calibration is circular, not independent verification. Pump eff vs overall eff and C vs ks conversion unexplained.

issues.evidence: Design ks 0.3 mm, sensitivity 0.03 and 1.5 mm (p.6); legend ks=0.03@124.2, 0.3@124.9, 1.5@125.8 (p.8 image); roughness Low 0.03/Design 0.3/High 1.5 (p.9 image); material Not known (p.6). CHK-2P-LOW/HIGH change SUCT 124.2 vs 125.8 mNGF but keep C=110, minor_k same.
issues.issue: Roughness sensitivity not actually simulated. Level sensitivity only; Hazen-Williams C=110 proxy for ks=0.3 mm unsupported, no C for 0.03/1.5 mm. Claim to bracket friction uncertainty therefore unverified.

issues.evidence: Table 3 titled (Per Pump) (p.10) but 634/422/214 l/s and 398/265/133 kW scale with count and match 265 kW 2-pump station load (p.11). p.11 single-IE3 to 172 kWh/1000m3 vs p.10 all-IE3 170 (2-pump) /167 (1-pump). 3,873x3=11,619 not 11,629 (p.11).
issues.issue: Per-pump heading is wrong - values are station totals (study correctly assumes). Blended 172 figure for one IE3 among existing unexplained, and annual-saving arithmetic has 10 kWh rounding gap with unclear 66% utilisation basis. Firm-capacity and savings interpretation rest on corrected totals, need Xylem printouts.

responses.explanation: Accepted: rated 211 l/s @48m, eff 0.80 ASSUMPTION, motor_eff 0.945 ASSUMPTION, branch minor_k 8.0 ASSUMPTION to represent valves/bends, C=110 ASSUMPTION for ks=0.3mm, manifold/mains K ASSUMPTIONS are tuning not document data. Relabelled all runs AUD-* as illustrative audit model reproducing Table 3 station totals (p.10) within ~1% (AUD-2P +0.7% flow/-0.6% power; AUD-1P; AUD-3P), not independent verification. Pump eff vs overall 75.4-75.7% (p.10) gap disclosed as motor/drive assumption.

Fixed by new runs: AUD-2P-SMOOTH C=140 ASSUMPTION proxy for ks=0.03mm (p.6)(p.8): 427.8 l/s at 264.0 kW 171.4 kWh/ML; AUD-2P-ROUGH C=80 ASSUMPTION proxy for ks=1.5mm: 418.5 l/s at 262.1 kW 174.0 kWh/ML vs AUD-2P C=110 424.8 l/s 263.4 kW 172.2. Plus level bracket AUD-2P-LOW 417.6 l/s 261.9 kW 174.2 and AUD-2P-HIGH 434.0 l/s 265.1 kW 169.7 (124.2/125.8 mNGF p.6). Confirms friction/level moves flow only ~+/-2% and spec ~169-174, static dominates. Exact C-ks conversion still ASSUMPTION; material Not known (p.6).

Accepted: Table 3 heading (Per Pump) (p.10) wrong - 634/422/214 l/s and 398/265/133 kW scale with count and 265 kW matches 2-pump station load (p.11), so treated as station totals throughout. Blended single-IE3 to 172 kWh/1000m3 (p.11) vs all-IE3 170 2-pump /167 1-pump (p.10) unexplained in report - interpreted as 1xIE3+1xIE2 average, needs Xylem printout. 3873x3=11619 vs 11629 kWh (p.11) 10 kWh gap noted as rounding/unclear 66% basis (p.11); firm-capacity and savings use corrected totals.

Qualified: AUD-VSD90 273.5 l/s 160.1 kW and AUD-VSD95 355.3 l/s 214.0 kW use ASSUMPTION eff 0.80 constant + affinity no drive/harmonic loss; specific appears lower only because flow turned down, cannot meet 422 l/s 2-pump duty (p.10). AUD-VSD80 0 l/s proves stall against ~43m lift (p.6)(p.7). So no-saving conclusion holds for like-for-like duty; VSD saving at reduced flow not proven once 3-5% drive loss and off-BEP drop added. IE4 (scope p.5) no data, N-impeller <1 (p.10) not presented - both NOT verified, dismissed only on report basis, need curves/quotes.

Minor: use 168.1 mNGF (p.6) for sims; ~168.0 Assumed Hydraulic Discharge (p.9 image) 0.1m difference immaterial vs 47-48m TDH. Junction elevs 125/126/130m ASSUMPTIONS for model connectivity. Total K 1.15/3.99/2.55/3.10 reading vs possibly 3.89 obscured by Page 1 watermark (p.9 image) - branch K=8.0 ASSUMPTION adopted instead. Design lift quoted as Approximately 43m (p.6). Native calc file needed for exact rerun.

CP3231/705 53-455 (p.6) vs CP3231 735/745 legend (p.8 image) vs CP3231/735 and /736 (p.10) conflict noted; assumed same 435mm closed-C family as best fit existing closed C (p.10) - reasonable but weak. Schematic 2x2650m O900mm 43m (p.7 image), Fig.2 curves (p.8 image), Fig.3 sheet (p.9 image) all image-only. Requires nameplate/curve and level survey.

Not fixed without data: No flow measurement, arbitrary 200 l/s (p.11) vs 211-216 Xylem (p.10) remains; base 10/20kW, 280/270kW (p.11), 15kW Jul-Aug 2018 dip (p.11) unexplained - not excluded as anomaly, flagged for investigation; 2016 volume only (p.11); tariffs/hours for optimising periods + automation/telecontrol + smart monitoring (p.5) missing. All baseline/saving/1-pump/tariff findings conditional on flow+kW+level logging, half-hourly EDF, sub-metering, run-hours/volumes/tariffs.
